label: Week 41, 2026
recap:
This week was quiet, with 16 bill movements and 4 case updates across 5 jurisdictions. New Jersey led with 8, followed by Ohio at 3, the District of Columbia and Pennsylvania at 2 each, and the United States Congress at 1. Five bills carried no theme.

The activity centered on children and minors, criminal law, and transparency and disclosure, each at 3. Health care, infrastructure and energy, and workforce and education followed at 2 each, while privacy and data and safety and frontier models each appeared once. No federal documents were recorded.
